en: A black-and-white image showing two women in fashionable 1960s attire, sitting at a round outdoor table by the water, writing postcards. The table and chairs are typical lightweight outdoor furniture. Behind them, there is an old stone bridge over a calm river or canal, leafy trees, a few other people sitting, and a historic-looking stone building partially visible on the right.
